description: This file defines an abstract generic class AbstractDataPopulator for data conversion, implementing the DataPopulator interface. It provides methods to set and get locale and a populate method to convert data from a source object to a target object, considering merchant store and language context.

classes.name: AbstractDataPopulator
classes.description: An abstract class that implements data population logic with methods for setting locale and populating data with context.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the Locale for data population.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Performs data population from source to target using store and language context; calls the abstract createTarget method.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new instance of the target type.
